headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty crashed 1,250 points to three-month lows amid rising crude prices and geopolitical tensions

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 29 September.

why: Sharp 1,250-point crash in the Sensex reaching three-month lows
Spike in global crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions in West Asia
Proposed insurance curbs impacting investor sentiment
FMCG sector pressure as rural volumes fell 5% in the June quarter
whatHappening: Bank unions to conduct a three-day nationwide strike starting Monday, impacting services
Electronics PLI beneficiaries receive Rs 19,091-crore in incentives following significant investment

summary: The Indian market is closed for the weekend following a sharp 1,250-point crash in the last session that hit three-month lows. Investors are monitoring a three-day nationwide bank strike starting Monday and the impact of falling rural demand on the FMCG sector. Positive developments include significant PLI incentive disbursements for electronics and the steady progress of the Tejas Mark 1A project.
